ja512:1.1: Ko pātur āsī tidivā nabhamhi obhāsayaṃ saṃvariṃ candimā va, gattehi te rasmiyo niccharanti sateratā vijju-r-iv' antalikkhe.
ja512:2.1: So chinnavātaṃ kamasī aghamhi, vehāsayaṃ gacchasi tiṭṭhasī ca, iddhī nu te vatthukatā subhāvitā anaddhagūnām api devatānaṃ.
ja512:3.1: Vehāsayaṃ saṃkammāgamma tiṭṭhasi ‘kumbham kiṇāthā' 'ti yam etam atthaṃ ko vā tuvaṃ kissa vatāya kumbho akkhāhi me brāhmaṇa etam atthan ti.
ja512:4.1: Na sappikumbho na pi telakumbho na phāṇitassa na madhussa kumbho, kumbhassa vajjāni anappakāni, dose bahū kumbhagate suṇātha.
ja512:5.1: Gaḷeyya yaṃ pītvā pate papātaṃ sobbhaṃ guhaṃ candaniyoligallaṃ bahum pi bhuñjeyya abhojaneyyaṃ tassā puṇṇaṃ kumbham imaṃ kiṇātha.
ja512:6.1: Yaṃ pītvā cittasmi anesamāno āhiṇḍatī go-r-iva bhakkhasārī anāthamāno upagāti naccati tassā puṇṇaṃ kumbham imaṃ kiṇātha.
ja512:7.1: Yaṃ ve pivitvā acelo va naggo careyya gāme visikhantarāni sammūḷharitto ativelasāyī tassā puṇṇaṃ kumbham imaṃ kiṇātha.
ja512:8.1: Yaṃ pītvā uṭṭhāya pavedhamāno sīsañ ca bāhañ ca pacālayanto so naccatī dārukaṭallako va etc. Yaṃ
ja512:9.1: ve pivitvā aggidaḍḍhā sayanti atho sigālehi pi khāditāse bandhaṃ vadhaṃ bhogajāniṃ c' upenti etc. Yaṃ
ja512:10.1: pītvā bhāseyya abhāsaneyyaṃ sabhāyam āsīno apetavattho sammakkhito vantagato vyasanno etc. Yaṃ
ja512:11.1: pītvā ukkaṭṭho āvilakkho mam' eva sabbā puthavīti maññe na me samo cāturanto pi rājā etc. Mānātimānā
ja512:12.1: kalahāni pesuṇāni dubbaṇṇinī naggayinī palāyinī corāna dhuttānaṃ gatī niketo etc. Iddhāni
ja512:13.1: phītāni kulāni assu anekasāhassadhanāni loke ucchinnadāyajjakatān' imāya etc. Dhaññam
ja512:14.1: dhanaṃ rajataṃ jātarūpaṃ khettaṃ gavaṃ yattha vināsayanti ucchedanī vittavataṃ kulānaṃ etc. Yañ
ja512:15.1: ce pītvā dittarūpo va poso akkosatī pitaraṃ mātarañ ca sassum pi gaṇheyya atho pi suṇhaṃ etc. Yañ
ja512:16.1: ce pītvā dittarūpā va nārī akkosatī sasuraṃ sāmikañ ca dāsam pi gaṇhe paricārakam pi etc. Yañ
ja512:17.1: ce pītvāna haneyya poso dhamme ṭhitaṃ samaṇaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vā gacche apāyam pi tatonidānaṃ etc. Yañ
ja512:18.1: ce pītvā duccaritaṃ caranti kāyena vācāya ca cetasā ca nirayaṃ vajanti duccaritaṃ caritvā etc. Yaṃ
ja512:19.1: yācamānā na labhanti pubbe bahuṃ hiraññam pi pariccajantā so taṃ pivitvā alikaṃ bhaṇāti etc. Yaṃ pivitvā pesane
ja512:20.1: pesiyanto accāyike karaṇīyamhi jāto attham pi so na-ppajānāti vutto etc. Hirīmanāpi
ja512:21.1: ahirīkabhāvaṃ pātuṃkaronti madirāya mattā, dhīrāpi santā bahukaṃ bhaṇanti etc. Yañ
ja512:22.1: ce pītvā ekathūpā sayanti anāsakā thaṇḍiladukkhaseyyā dubbaṇṇiyaṃ āyasakkañ c' upenti etc. Yañ
ja512:23.1: ce pītvā pattakkhandhā [sayanti] gāvo kūṭahatā-r-iva na hi vāruṇiyā vego narena susaho-r-iva. Yaṃ manussā vivajjenti sappaṃ ghoravisaṃ
ja512:24.1: iva taṃ loke visasamānaṃ ko naro pātum arahati.
ja512:25.1: Yañ ce pivitvā Andhakaveṇhuputtā samuddatīre paricārayantā upakkamuṃ musalehi aññamaññaṃ etc. Yañ
ja512:26.1: ce pītvā pubbadevā pamattā tidivā cutā sassatiyā samāyā taṃ tādisaṃ majjam imaṃ niratthakaṃ jānaṃ mahārāja kathaṃ pipeyya.
ja512:27.1: Na imasmi kumbhasmiṃ dadhi vā madhuṃ vā evaṃ abhiññāya kiṇāhi rāja, evaṃ hi maṃkumbhagatā mayā te, akkhātarūpaṃ tava Sabbamittā 'ti.
ja512:28.1: Na me pitā vā athavāpi mātā etādisā yādisako tuvaṃ si, hitānukampī paramatthakāmo So 'haṃ karissaṃ vacanaṃ tav' ajja.
ja512:29.1: Dadāmi te gāmavarāni pañca dāsīsataṃ satta gavaṃ satāni ājaññayutte ca rathe dasā ime, ācariyo hosi mam' atthakāmo
ja512:30.1: ti. Tav' eva dāsīsatam atthu rāja, gāmā ca gāvo ca tav' eva hontu, ājaññayuttā ca rathā tav' eva, Sakko 'ham asmī tidasānam indo.
ja512:31.1: Maṃsodanaṃ sappipāyāsaṃ bhuñja, khādassu ce tvaṃ madhunā apūpe, evaṃ tuvaṃ dhammarato janinda anindito saggam upehi ṭhānan ti.
